answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: an ssh login descends from sshd-session. Measured on akiendelllinux 2026-11-18: ps shows 1520885 sshd-session (parent 1729 sshd) and 1520928 sshd-session under it, cgroup session-4397.scope. Older OpenSSH names the per-connection child sshd; both names are accepted, and the listener is never an ancestor of a local shell.
